sections.heading: 4. Application Health
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-128/health.png)

Application Health Dashboard Overview. Identity API HTTP 500s dropped from 14 to 5. Content API HTTP 500s rose from 180 to 12k, most of them in a spike on 14 Oct - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-128/commits.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 38,920 (flat on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-128/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - New accounts were 7% last Sprint and are now 7% (9 of 127). Invited collaborators were 20% and are now 24% (25 of 105) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-128/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 130 new organisations, down from 141 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-128/dau.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 705 on 29 Sep, and at about 660 on 14 Oct this Sprint (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-128/geo.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the last 30 days - US is our top country with 1,593 users, down 102 on the prior 30 days, ahead of Germany on 566 and the UK on 524 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

sections.heading: 7. Cloners of Starter Templates
sections.note: Current Sprint counts cover Tue 13 Oct to Sun 18 Oct - GitHub's traffic API had not published Mon 19 Oct when this was built.

sections.heading: 8. TinaCMS NPM Version Distribution
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-128/npm.png)

TinaCMS version downloads over the last week, the most popular version is v3.14.x with 37k total downloads over the last 7 days (up 25%), ahead of v3.12.x on 4k. v3.15.x shipped on 19 Oct and has no downloads recorded yet - [Tina Tracker](https://tina-dashboard-nine.vercel.app/downloads)
